page.title: Invite someone you know in person
page.intro: Invites only work face to face: the person you invite scans a code on your screen.

budget.available: {count, plural, =0 {No invites saved} one {# invite saved} other {# invites saved}} (up to {cap})
budget.full: Your invites are full. Use one before more can build up.
budget.probationIntro: New accounts can't invite anyone yet.
budget.probationFriends: {count, plural, one {# more friend} other {# more friends}} outside your invite tree
budget.revoked: You can no longer invite people.
budget.probationFriendsPlus: {count, plural, one {# more friend+} other {# more friends+}} outside your invite tree (verified in person)

countdown.days: {d, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} {h, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}

hs.scanHint: Ask the person you're inviting to open {url} on their phone and scan this code.
hs.claimed: Someone scanned your code. Check that their screen shows the same number:
hs.confirmed: Waiting for them to create their account…
hs.doneRecovery: Done. The account's recovery can continue.

errors.no_invites: You have no invites saved right now.
errors.on_probation: New accounts can't invite anyone yet.

mode.quiet: Quiet: only the near-silent tone, no jingle
mode.dual: Without sound: each phone scans the other's code

sound.listening: Listening… Ask them to tap "Play the sound" with their phone close to yours.
sound.listeningQuiet: Listening for the near-silent tone… Ask them to tap "Play the sound" with their phone close to yours.

dual.hint: Now let them scan this second code.

outcome.retryJingle: We couldn't hear the quiet tone. Ask them to switch the jingle on and play it again.
outcome.noAttempts: No tries left. Cancel and show a new code.
